$comment: POST /partners/claims. The site says that one of its organizations, which the hub lists, is the same as an organization kept on the hub, so that its work is counted once. `organization` is the site's identifier of its own organization. `address` is the address of the hub organization's page. With `withdraw`, a request that waits is taken back, or one that was accepted is ended, and no address is needed. Nothing here names a person.
